notes: Optical-clock (171Yb+ E3/E2 frequency ratio) search for oscillating nuclear charge radius from ultralight DM. Paper reports NEW 95% CL limits on scalar UDM-nuclear couplings d_g (gluon) and d_mhat (quark mass), plus QCD axion 1/f_a. No numeric exclusion table given; only figures (Fig.1, Fig.2) and a text statement that relative-amplitude limits are below ~2e-17 over frequency range 1.4e-8 Hz to 0.005 Hz (masses ~6e-23 to 2e-17 eV), with limits weakened by factor 3 for stochastic amplitude. The two data points are ROUGH derivations of the d_g bound at the two mass endpoints using Eq.(10) with K=2.4e-3, alpha=-1.1, rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3; the bound rises ~linearly in mass. Coupling type is ambiguous between ScalarNucleon (d_g), ScalarBaryon, or the quark-mass coupling d_mhat, and the paper also gives an AxionMass/1-over-f_a plot — hence low confidence.
